scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: The school phone rang six times today — and one call was for Kili. A condor with phone calls, imagine that!
scene.intro: The school phone rang six times today and one call was very strange. Hello, can I speak to the director, please? Could you hold on a moment? said Kili, who should never answer a phone. He took a message, lost it, found it, and read it upside down. One caller had the wrong number and stayed talking for ten minutes anyway. Can YOU answer the phone in English? Practise it!

data.script: Diego: School phone, Diego speaking! … Diego: Call one: the bus driver. The school trip bus will arrive at quarter past nine, not nine. … Diego: Call two: Oliver's mum. He forgot his lunch box — again! … Diego: Call three: wrong number. Somebody wanted a pizza restaurant. … Diego: Call four: the library. Maya's science book has arrived. … Diego: Call five: the vet! Kili's new vitamins are ready. Yes, the call was for Kili! … Diego: And call six… my own grandma, just to say good luck with my report. Thanks, grandma!

Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the boy in the red shirt with a microphone? … Maya: That is Diego. Look, Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the boy with curly brown hair and a green shirt? … Maya: That is Bruno. Look, Bruno is running after the ball. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey. … Diego: And who is the man in the blue shirt? … Maya: That is Mr Vega. Look, Mr Vega is showing the way to the sports centre.
